magic-longsword.name: +1 Longsword
magic-longsword.description: Well balanced and etched with runes; magical.

magic-mace.name: +1 Mace
magic-mace.description: A blessed mace; crushing and magical.

potion-of-strength.name: Potion of Strength
potion-of-strength.description: +2 SKILL for one fight. Drink it before (or during) the fight.

luminous-vial.name: Luminous Blue Vial
luminous-vial.description: Permanently +1 SKILL, but costs 1 LUCK when drunk.

silver-key.name: Silver Key
silver-key.description: One of the three things that bind the Widow.

true-name.name: The Widow's True Name
true-name.description: Eliza Hollow. One of the three things that bind the Widow.

mayors-ledger.name: Mayor's Ledger
mayors-ledger.description: Payments to the Hollow Faith cult; proof for the Mayor.

alchemists-journal.name: Alchemist's Journal
alchemists-journal.description: Notes on the binding of the Widow.
alchemists-journal.text:
A torn, bloodstained page:

"The Widow is bound by silver chains and dark magic, but the binding is imperfect. It was never meant to last forever - only long enough for the guilty generation to die in peace.

To properly seal her spirit for eternity requires three components: silver forged specifically for binding (such as the Silver Key), her true name spoken with authority, and the ritual performed at the moment of greatest supernatural power (midnight on the anniversary of her binding).

Without all three components, the binding will be temporary at best. The Widow will eventually break free again, perhaps even more powerful than before."

cult-medallion.name: Cult Medallion
cult-medallion.description: Might let you pass as one of them.

mysterious-potion.name: Mysterious Potion
mysterious-potion.description: A dark swirling liquid. You can drink it when the story offers it.

old-key.name: Old Key
old-key.description: "Might open doors deeper in the manor": it opens brass and iron locks (not the silver one).

holy-symbol.name: Holy Symbol
holy-symbol.description: Blessed silver: +1 to saving throws against undead.

holy-symbol-of-binding.name: Holy Symbol of Binding
holy-symbol-of-binding.description: Blessed at the altar: +2 to saving throws against undead.

amulet-of-the-grave.name: Amulet of the Grave
amulet-of-the-grave.description: Absorbs dark energy: +2 to saving throws against undead and spectral creatures.

silver-ring.name: Silver Ring
silver-ring.description: Worth 30 gold. Worn against the dead: +1 to saving throws against undead.

golden-ring.name: Golden Ring
golden-ring.description: Pure gold, worth a considerable sum. Its 40 gold was added to your purse when you took it.

eliza-ring.name: Eliza's Wedding Ring
eliza-ring.description: The ring Thomas gave her. +2 to the binding ritual (and +1 LUCK for finding it).

cloak-of-shadows.name: Cloak of Shadows
cloak-of-shadows.description: Absorbs light: +2 when you sneak or hide.

potion-of-invisibility.name: Potion of Invisibility
potion-of-invisibility.description: Invisible for 5 moves (the book says ten minutes) or until you attack: sneaking always works, you can slip away from any fight, and your first blow from hiding gets +2.

scroll.name: Ancient Scroll
scroll.description: Wax-sealed, in faded script. It names the Widow.
scroll.text: "Let it be known to any who seek to bind the vengeful spirit: The Widow's true name, hidden from all but those who dare to search the darkest places, is ELIZA HOLLOW. Speak this name with authority and proper binding, and her power may be contained. But beware - to speak her name is to draw her attention. Be certain you are prepared to face her wrath before you invoke it."

scroll-of-protection.name: Scroll of Protection
scroll-of-protection.description: Read it before or during a fight: +2 to your saving throws for that whole fight.

diary.name: Skeleton's Diary
diary.text:
"Day 12 of captivity: The Widow's wail is stronger tonight. It pierces the walls, pierces my ears, pierces my very mind. I cannot sleep.

Day 13: Sleep deprivation is taking its toll. I hear things that aren't there. See shadows that move when I'm not looking. The food is almost gone.

Day 14: They're at the door. I can hear them scratching, moaning, calling my name in voices of the dead. I've barricaded myself in, but I know it won't hold forever. If anyone finds this - tell my family I love them. Tell them I -"

The entry ends there, unfinished. The diary tells you nothing useful, only how deadly the curse is.

prayer-book.name: Prayer Book
prayer-book.description: Old but well preserved. Reading it blessed your next fight (+1 SKILL, +1 to saving throws).
prayer-book.text:
"Grant strength to those who face darkness. Grant courage to those who stand against evil. Grant protection to those who defend the innocent."

One passage has been circled again and again. Reading the prayers fills you with peace and spiritual strength.

old-tome.name: Old Tome
old-tome.description: A history of the Hollow family.
old-tome.text:
The one book in the library that is still readable: a history of the Hollow family that confirms everything you have learned about the curse.

It gives detailed accounts of the wedding massacre, of the binding ritual, and of when the binding would fail.

torn-map.name: Torn Map
torn-map.description: A secret entrance that bypasses the main defences. It shows the traps and hazards of the manor: the ways that lead to one are marked ⚠.

catacomb-map.name: Map of the Catacombs
catacomb-map.description: Etched into the wall by a long-dead explorer. It shows the traps and hazards of the catacombs: the ways that lead to one are marked ⚠.

tomb-map.name: Map of the Hollow Tomb
tomb-map.description: Shows where the Hollow family tomb lies in the cemetery.
tomb-map.text: A map showing the location of the Hollow family tomb in the cemetery, found with the letter that says the Amulet of the Grave rests there.

manor-map.name: Map of the Manor
manor-map.description: Secret passages, hidden rooms and safe routes. It shows the traps and hazards of the manor: the ways that lead to one are marked ⚠.

hollow-letter.name: Letter from the Hollow Study
hollow-letter.description: A clue about the Amulet of the Grave.
hollow-letter.text:
A letter written in a shaking hand:

"To whoever finds this: The Amulet of the Grave rests in our family tomb. It can absorb dark energy and protect against spectral attacks. You'll need it to survive a confrontation with the Widow."
